question.instructions: Choose the least expensive model tier that can fully answer the request in `prompt`.

economy.description: Everyday language tasks that need no technical expertise.

mid.description: Routine software or technical work a competent engineer finishes quickly.
examples: write or fix a short function or script
write a config file or query

high.description: Tasks that need rigorous multi-step reasoning, even when the prompt is short.
examples: derive a formula from first principles
diagnose a subtle concurrency or race-condition bug
design and justify a correct concurrent algorithm
